reuse.why: Adds one shared assertion used by all five provider link functions, though it is called from each provider rather than inside the existing shared linkBankSyncAccount path.

duplication.why: The rule's query is defined once; only a short call with the provider's sync-source literal is repeated at five sites, restating the string each already passes to linkBankSyncAccount.

placement.why: Lives in accounts/app.ts next to linkBankSyncAccount; calling it before findOrCreateBank keeps the no-side-effect guarantee, at the cost of not being inside the one shared link step.

scope.why: Only the link guard, its calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: Clear named guard with a single query; a future provider must remember to call it, since it is not enforced by linkBankSyncAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link functions still go through linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
